facts: About 2.1 million people (2023), over a third of the country
On the north bank of the Congo River, opposite Kinshasa
worth_knowing: Named for the explorer Pierre Savorgnan de Brazza, credited with founding the town. From 1940 to 1942 it was the de facto capital of Free France.
